body: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust BXDC was raised to Buy from Neutral at Citi Research, with the price target reduced to $20.00 from $23.00.Shares were 1.74% higher at $16.95 during pre-market trading on Monday."Blackstone Digital Infrastructure went public with a strategy to acquire high-quality, stabilized data centers occupied by IG-rated hyper-scalers and in well-established data center markets under a Blind Pool structure," said analyst Michael Rollins."However, no deals have yet been announced, and Blackstone still has an opportunity to invest the capital raised. The market is likely to apply a higher cap rate to the assets BXDC purchases in the future given the higher interest rate environment," said Rollins."However, we also believe BXDC retains an opportunity to remain disciplined and pursue assets that are in the upper half of its previously disclosed buy-box cap rate range of 5.75%-7.00%," said the research note.Citi's rating aligns with the Wall Street analysts rating of Buy.
